question.text:
How many of the following are lanthanides?
Uranium, praseodymium, erbium, gadolinium, curium, hafnium, osmium, iridium

solution.text: Praseodymium <math> <mrow>  <mtext>(Pr),</mtext></mrow></math> erbium <math> <mrow>  <mfenced>   <mrow>    <mtext>Er</mtext></mrow>  </mfenced></mrow></math> and gadolinium <math> <mrow>  <mfenced>   <mrow>    <mtext>Gd</mtext></mrow>  </mfenced></mrow></math> are lanthanoids.
